_help: Day 3, room 3: the bedroom, 'The window' (1950s). Maman's song is Mamie's lullaby the other way round (Day 1's note); two halves of a diary page give the time Papa's boat left, for the clock on the wall. See docs/STORY.md.

locks._why: The key to the landing was behind the clock on the wall.
hints: The way back down is locked.
The key from the wall clock opens the door to the landing.
Select the brass key, then tap the door to the landing.

locks._why: Maman sang Mamie's lullaby (Day 1: star, wave, shell) the other way round, 'from the morning back to the night': shell, wave, star.
hints: You've heard this song before, on the first night. Only the other way round.
Maman's song belongs to the jewellery box; the lullaby from the first day is in your notebook.
The lullaby backwards: shell, wave, star.

locks._why: The other half of the diary page is under the bed; only Chloé fits.
hints: Half a page is missing. Somewhere dusty.
Tap Chloé, then tap under the bed.

locks._why: The diary page in two halves: Papa left 'at twenty... to six': twenty to six on the wall clock.
hints: When did Papa's boat leave? The diary knows, in two halves.
The two halves of the diary page belong to the clock on the wall.
